# Features

*Written by AI from the code at this commit. Check important details against the source.*

A cross‑platform GTK# library and application that provide a modular task‑tracking core, interchangeable storage back‑ends, and optional Google Drive synchronization.

## Pluggable task and storage management

Define, retrieve, bind, update, and delete tasks through [`ITaskManager`](api/TaskManagerInterface/ITaskManager.md) without caring about the underlying persistence mechanism. Swap between in‑memory, database, or stub implementations via [`IStorageManager`](api/TaskManagerInterface/IStorageManager.md) and [`IStorageRepository`](api/TaskManagerInterface/IStorageRepository.md).

- [`ITaskManager`](api/TaskManagerInterface/ITaskManager.md): exposes task datasets and CRUD operations
- [`IStorageManager`](api/TaskManagerInterface/IStorageManager.md): coordinates persistence for any manager
- [`IStorageRepository`](api/TaskManagerInterface/IStorageRepository.md): low‑level API for reading/writing the DataSet
- [`IRepositoryCruid`](api/TaskManagerInterface/IRepositoryCruid.md): creates storage command objects for CRUD
- [`CommandFactory`](api/GanttTracker.TaskManager.TaskStorage/CommandFactory.md): concrete builder of storage commands
- [`StorageRepository`](api/GanttTracker.TaskManager.TaskStorage/StorageRepository.md): concrete repository implementation backed by a DataSet
- [`ManagerFactory`](api/GanttTracker.TaskManager/ManagerFactory.md): produces the appropriate ITaskManager based on CoreState
- [`IManagerFactory`](api/TaskManagerInterface/IManagerFactory.md): factory interface for ITaskManager creation

Projects: [GanttMonoTracker](projects/GanttMonoTracker.md)

## Unified GUI core and dialog handling

Use [`IGuiCore`](api/TaskManagerInterface/IGuiCore.md) to obtain the current application state, task manager, and storage manager, and to show dialogs through [`IGuiMessageDialog`](api/TaskManagerInterface/IGuiMessageDialog.md). [`MessageFactory`](api/GanttMonoTracker.ExceptionPresentation/MessageFactory.md) creates concrete dialogs for errors, warnings, and informational messages, keeping UI code independent of specific dialog classes.

- [`IGuiCore`](api/TaskManagerInterface/IGuiCore.md): central entry point for UI components and core services
- [`IGuiMessageDialog`](api/TaskManagerInterface/IGuiMessageDialog.md): contract for disposable dialogs with Title and ShowDialog()
- [`MessageFactory`](api/GanttMonoTracker.ExceptionPresentation/MessageFactory.md): creates concrete IGuiMessageDialog implementations
- [`IGuiTracker`](api/TaskManagerInterface/IGuiTracker.md): exposes actor, state, and task sources for binding to UI controls
- [`IGuiSource`](api/TaskManagerInterface/IGuiSource.md): injects task or assignment data into visual widgets

Projects: [GanttMonoTracker](projects/GanttMonoTracker.md)

## Google Drive cloud synchronization

Integrate Google Drive storage with [`GDriveManager`](api/GanttMonoTracker/GDriveManager.md), which handles OAuth via [`GDriveCredentials`](api/GanttMonoTracker/GDriveCredentials.md) and provides [`GDriveUploader`](api/GanttMonoTracker/GDriveUploader.md) and [`GDriveDownloader`](api/GanttMonoTracker/GDriveDownloader.md) for uploading and downloading the XML‑based DataSet.

- [`GDriveManager`](api/GanttMonoTracker/GDriveManager.md): encapsulates authentication and provides uploader/downloader services
- [`GDriveCredentials`](api/GanttMonoTracker/GDriveCredentials.md): holds OAuth client IDs and credential objects
- [`GDriveUploader`](api/GanttMonoTracker/GDriveUploader.md): uploads raw XML data to Drive, creating or updating files
- [`GDriveDownloader`](api/GanttMonoTracker/GDriveDownloader.md): downloads a file from Drive using supplied credentials

Projects: [GanttMonoTracker](projects/GanttMonoTracker.md)

## Domain entity lifecycle abstraction

Implement persistent domain objects (projects, tasks, states, actors, connections) by conforming to [`IManagerEntity`](api/TaskManagerInterface/IManagerEntity.md). The interface supplies `Id`, state flags, parent manager reference, and lifecycle methods `BindData()`, `Save()`, and `Delete()`.

- [`IManagerEntity`](api/TaskManagerInterface/IManagerEntity.md): base contract for all persistable domain objects
- [`ITask`](api/TaskManagerInterface/ITask.md): minimal data contract for a scheduled work item
- [`IState`](api/TaskManagerInterface/IState.md): data contract for a state entity with color and mapping info
- [`IGuiConnection`](api/TaskManagerInterface/IGuiConnection.md): UI contract for visualizing connections between tasks

Projects: [GanttMonoTracker](projects/GanttMonoTracker.md)

## Core utilities for data handling and UI rendering

Leverage helper classes such as [`DataSearch`](api/Arise.Logic/DataSearch.md) for regex‑based table filtering, [`IdentityManager`](api/Arise.Logic/IdentityManager.md) for generating unique IDs, [`FSLocations`](api/GanttMonoTracker/FSLocations.md) for file‑path resolution, [`GanttDataSetBuilder`](api/GanttMonoTracker/GanttDataSetBuilder.md) for constructing the in‑memory schema, and [`GdkPalette`](api/GanttMonoTracker/GdkPalette.md) for creating GDK graphics contexts.

- [`DataSearch`](api/Arise.Logic/DataSearch.md): filters DataTable rows using regular expressions
- [`IdentityManager`](api/Arise.Logic/IdentityManager.md): generates sequential integer IDs for runtime objects
- [`FSLocations`](api/GanttMonoTracker/FSLocations.md): computes absolute file system paths relative to the assembly
- [`GanttDataSetBuilder`](api/GanttMonoTracker/GanttDataSetBuilder.md): builds the DataSet schema required by the tracker
- [`GdkPalette`](api/GanttMonoTracker/GdkPalette.md): provides helpers to create and dispose GDK graphics contexts with preset colors

Projects: [Arise](projects/Arise.md), [GanttMonoTracker](projects/GanttMonoTracker.md)
